# Blender Agent Studio

This repository is a Codex plugin marketplace containing the
`blender-agent-studio` plugin.

Install:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ifBars/blender-agent-studio
codex plugin add blender-agent-studio@blender-agent-studio
```

Core capabilities:

- reproducible procedural Blender modeling;
- authored-scene and fresh-export validation;
- standardized multiview and animation evidence;
- mechanical animation guidance;
- isolated baseline/plugin/MCP agent benchmarks;
- a bounded local evaluation MCP.

The plugin source is under `plugins/blender-agent-studio/`. Generated models,
renders, exports, and benchmark runs are intentionally excluded from git.
